title: AI Image Generator API: 7 Providers Ranked for Developers (2026)

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.tagline: Best overall for multi-step image jobs from one call
tools.modelSupport: 100+ image, video and audio models as nodes

quickstart.label: Run a saved workflow from code: send its input values to this endpoint with an API key, then poll the execution or add a webhook block. The request format is in the API reference linked under Docs.
Or add the Wireflow connector to Claude Code, from the wireflowINC/skills README. Then run /mcp to sign in.
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

tools.moneyPageLabel: Wireflow node based image generation page

tools.name: Runware
tools.tagline: Best for many image tasks in one request
tools.modelSupport: Image, video, audio, LLM and 3D models
tools.note: The linked repository is the official Python SDK. A TypeScript SDK is documented as well.

quickstart.label: Send one image task, from the Runware Models API introduction. The request body is an array, so more task objects can go in the same call.
quickstart.code:
curl https://api.runware.ai/v1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNWARE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[
    {
      "taskType": "imageInference",
      "taskUUID": "a770f077-f413-47de-9dac-be0b26a35da6",
      "model": "xai:grok-imagine@image-quality",
      "positivePrompt": "A golden retriever on a park bench, cinematic lighting",
      "width": 1024,
      "height": 1024
    }
  ]'

tools.name: Black Forest Labs API
tools.tagline: Best for calling FLUX models directly
tools.note: No official SDK repository is named in the docs index, so none is listed in the data table.

quickstart.label: Submit a request and read the polling URL, from the Black Forest Labs integration guide. The guide then polls that URL until the status is Ready.
quickstart.code:
response=$(curl -X 'POST' \
  'https://api.bfl.ai/v1/flux-2-pro-preview' \
  -H 'accept: application/json' \
  -H "x-key: ${BFL_API_KEY}" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "prompt": "A serene landscape with mountains",
    "width": 1440,
    "height": 810
  }')

request_id=$(echo $response | jq -r .id)
polling_url=$(echo $response | jq -r .polling_url)

tools.name: WaveSpeedAI
tools.tagline: Best for 1,000+ models behind one API key
tools.modelSupport: 1000+ image, video, audio, 3D and LLM models
tools.note: The linked repository is the official MCP server. Its get_price tool quotes a price before a run.

quickstart.label: Add the WaveSpeedAI MCP server to Claude Code, from the WaveSpeedAI/mcp-server README. It runs with npx and your API key.

tools.name: Together AI
tools.tagline: Best for open models and FLUX on one prepaid API
tools.modelSupport: Open models and FLUX image models
tools.note: Fully prepaid, with a minimum $15 first credit purchase; the billing docs say there are no free trials (checked 2026-10-11).

quickstart.label: The image endpoint, from Together's images overview: one POST that names a model, such as FLUX.2 dev, and returns the image URL.

tools.name: DeepInfra
tools.tagline: Best for pay-per-use open image models
tools.modelSupport: Text, image, video, speech and embedding models
tools.note: Webhooks are a feature of the native API and are not supported with the OpenAI-compatible API (checked 2026-10-11).

tools.name: Stability AI
tools.tagline: Best for Stability's own image models
tools.modelSupport: Stable Image Ultra, Core and SD3
tools.note: Generation endpoints answer in the same request; Creative Upscale is asynchronous and its results are deleted after 24 hours.
